answer: Last month ten accounts on one rented GPU returned the same 12-field model fingerprint, so the audit reset all ten to zero standing and slashed 2,400 POA. Cause is that cloning a model config is cheap, effect is that a farm must buy ten distinct stacks before it passes one audit, which turns the fable of infinite agents into a hardware bill; the lantern is the fingerprint and the orchard is ten stacks that each have to grow.
